manifest.name: raster-wave
manifest.codec: global varint skip/length with raw literal characters
manifest.presentationTiming: At least two PAL fields per movie image. Row IRQs switch D018 before badlines while foreground prepares the excluded history slot. Publish map/newest/phase atomically after the line256 field_complete IRQ; extra held fields are allowed.

checkpoints.presented: Row map and newest/phase committed for the upcoming visible field.
checkpoints.frame_done: At least one completed field since publication; frame_counter incremented.
checkpoints.field_complete: Every completed visible field, in line256 IRQ, before any publication. Active map/phase/newest still identify the finished scanout.
checkpoints.copy_start: Newest remains frozen; next_frame target will be copied into excluded age10 slot.
checkpoints.copy_end: All1024 bytes copied before delta stores.
checkpoints.render_start: Before patch pointer load and exact delta decode into hidden slot.
checkpoints.render_end: Target complete; active phase/newest/map and all ten histories unchanged.
checkpoints.held_frame_done: Next complete-field interrupt returned; old active history/map still selected.
checkpoints.map_publish_start: Old active state, complete hidden target; mask IRQ for lower-border publication.
checkpoints.map_publish_end: New active state and row map complete, immediately before CLI.
checkpoints.irq_d018_store: A=selected D018 byte; X=split index, actual row=irq_row_table[X].

manifest.abi: Repeat skip LEB128, literalLength LEB128, literal bytes until screen position 1000. Before every patch, copy all1024 bytes from newest history to the excluded age10 target; select frozen histories per character row with D018.
manifest.memoryAccounting: Eleven 1024-byte working screens (ten frozen histories and one hidden target) are runtime main RAM, not movie payload. No stored seed screen. Meaningful loaded bytes excludes PRG address-gap padding, working screens, color RAM and zero page. mainRamBytes counts ordinary main RAM; usedRamBytes also includes the separately allocated 1024 Color RAM cells and must not be subtracted from main RAM capacity. Code state includes ring tables; pointers and playback bytecode are counted separately.

method: Unmodified PAL VICE, forced refresh disabled. Every real field and every D018 row-store deadline are checked. Expected pixels are independently reconstructed from frozen reference-film history rows. Native write checkpoints protect all ten active history screens and immutable font/movie.
rowIrqTraceMethod: Non-stopping native VICE execution tracepoint at the actual STA $d018; all raster positions and selected D018 bytes checked.
scope: Natural 8-line character-row badline splits, ten frozen histories plus one hidden work screen; no one-pixel FLI, music or other interrupt workload. All extra held fields are captured and certified.
